name: How long does it take to replace damaged boards?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace damaged boards?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of damaged board replacement depends on the size and complexity of the project. Small, isolated areas might be completed within a day. Larger projects, or those requiring extensive preparation and custom cuts, could take several days to a week. We provide an estimated timeline with your project quote after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on size and complexity, ranging from a day for small areas to several days or a week for larger projects.
